name: Surveyor's Toybox
description: Fit oriented 3D survey cuboids to a sparse toy-depot scan and connect synchronized camera marks to the same physical objects.
natural_language: Survey the miniature depot. Orbit, pan, or zoom the sparse point cloud as needed, fit a 3D cuboid around each requested object, correct its position, dimensions and heading until the synchronized camera projections agree, then link every camera mark to its matching cuboid.

metadata.variant_count_kind: 10 seeded object arrangements × six headings × three palettes × three frame counts × bounded point perturbations
metadata.notes: The scan points and camera marks are rendered evidence from one original oriented-box world. The server replays box edits and exact per-frame, per-view mark links; no browser completion flag is trusted.
